picks.title: Uprising
picks.highlight: 雷鬼传奇经典再版,信念与反抗的旋律依旧滚烫,值得整张循环的夏日之声。
picks.highlightEn: The reggae legend's classic reissued — defiant grooves and gospel-tinged hope for endless summer spins.
picks.summary: 1980年经典专辑再版,根源雷鬼与福音和声交织,主题围绕信念与抗争,是雷鬼乐史的里程碑。
picks.summaryEn: Reissue of the 1980 classic: roots reggae meets gospel harmony, themed on faith and resistance — a reggae milestone.

picks.title: The Stooges
picks.highlight: 朋克史前史的起点,原始粗粝的吉他轰鸣,一次就上瘾的车库摇滚暴击。
picks.highlightEn: Where punk was born: raw, feral garage riffing that still feels dangerous. Essential listening.
picks.summary: 1969年车库摇滚开山之作,粗糙吉他与狂野演唱定义了proto-punk,影响后世无数乐队。
picks.summaryEn: The 1969 garage-rock touchstone whose raw guitars and feral vocals defined proto-punk for generations.

picks.title: Leather Temple
picks.highlight: 合成器浪潮大师回归,暗黑复古的电子音墙,像80年代科幻片配乐般上头。
picks.highlightEn: Synthwave master returns with a dark retro electro wall of sound — like an 80s sci-fi soundtrack.
picks.summary: 法国电子音乐人Carpenter Brut新专辑,合成器浪潮结合摇滚吉他,暗黑复古、电影感强烈。
picks.summaryEn: French producer Carpenter Brut blends synthwave with rock guitars — darkly retro and deeply cinematic.

picks.title: PHASE I : Soft Violence
picks.highlight: 泰民全新篇章,柔美与暴力交织的舞台感流行,韩流顶级solo的又一次进化。
picks.highlightEn: TAEMIN's new chapter: softness meets violence in theatrical pop — another evolution from K-pop's finest soloist.
picks.summary: 韩国人气solo歌手泰民新专辑,主打舞台表现力,风格在流行舞曲与暗色电子之间切换。
picks.summaryEn: K-pop soloist TAEMIN returns with performance-driven pop that shifts between dance hooks and dark electronics.

picks.title: Snow, Vol. 9
picks.highlight: 冬日Lo-Fi系列第九辑,温暖采样与慵懒节拍,学习工作的最佳背景音。
picks.highlightEn: The ninth volume of warm, dusty lo-fi beats — the perfect companion for study or slow mornings.
picks.summary: 德国Lo-Fi嘻哈制作人Wun Two的冬日系列第九辑,采样温暖、节拍慵懒,适合放松与专注。
picks.summaryEn: Wun Two's winter series continues with warm samples and lazy beats — ideal for relaxing or focusing.

picks.title: Monument
picks.highlight: 德国哥特金属老将新作,沉重Riff与交响氛围交织,黑暗而壮丽的一次纪念碑。
picks.highlightEn: German gothic metal veterans deliver heavy riffs and symphonic darkness — a monumental, brooding statement.
picks.summary: 德国哥特金属乐队Crematory新作,厚重吉他、工业元素与交响氛围,主题沉重而宏大。
picks.summaryEn: Crematory's new record stacks heavy guitars, industrial textures and symphonic atmosphere into a grand, bleak sound.

picks.title: RAVEPOP
picks.artist: r u s s e l b u c k
picks.highlight: 快乐硬核、Donk与网络亚文化熔于一炉,高能量狂欢,越听越上头的电子异类。
picks.highlightEn: Happy hardcore, donk and internet subculture fused into a high-energy rave oddity you can't stop replaying.
picks.summary: 融合快乐硬核、Donk、Jersey Club等元素的实验电子专辑,节奏高速、能量爆棚,亚文化色彩浓。
picks.summaryEn: An experimental electronic album fusing happy hardcore, donk and Jersey club — fast, euphoric and proudly subcultural.

picks.title: The Great Adventure
picks.highlight: 瑞士舞曲常青树的冒险之旅,标志性欧陆节拍与合唱旋律,派对气氛瞬间拉满。
picks.highlightEn: Swiss dance-pop mainstay returns with euphoric eurodance hooks and singalong choruses built for the dancefloor.
picks.summary: 瑞士欧陆舞曲代表DJ BoBo新专辑,旋律朗朗上口、节拍明快,延续其派对流行风格。
picks.summaryEn: DJ BoBo's new album keeps his signature eurodance formula: bright tempos, huge choruses and pure party energy.

picks.title: Nothing Hurts Like Everything
picks.highlight: 加拿大音乐人的情感专辑,克制的编曲包裹失落的重量,温柔却直击心底。
picks.highlightEn: A quietly devastating Canadian record — restrained arrangements carrying the full weight of heartbreak.
picks.summary: 加拿大音乐人的另类流行专辑,编曲克制、情绪低沉,围绕失落与自我疗愈展开。
picks.summaryEn: A Canadian alt-pop album of restraint and sorrow, circling loss and self-healing with unusual subtlety.

picks.title: Appalachia
picks.highlight: 来自阿巴拉契亚的民谣叙事,清澈嗓音与细腻笔触,讲述土地、家庭与记忆。
picks.highlightEn: Clear-voiced Appalachian storytelling — songs of land, family and memory, told with a novelist's eye.
picks.summary: 美国创作歌手Emily Scott Robinson新专辑,以阿巴拉契亚为背景,民谣叙事温暖细腻。
picks.summaryEn: Emily Scott Robinson's new record paints Appalachia through tender, finely observed folk storytelling.

picks.title: The Lighthouse Session II
picks.highlight: 丹麦厄运金属诗篇的现场篇章,缓慢沉重Riff与哀美旋律,适合深夜独自聆听。
picks.highlightEn: A slow, sorrowful doom session from the Danish veterans — gorgeous, crushing and best heard alone at night.
picks.summary: 丹麦厄运金属乐队Saturnus的现场录音EP,缓慢沉重的Riff与哀美旋律,氛围幽暗深沉。
picks.summaryEn: Danish doom band Saturnus in session: slow, crushing riffs and mournful melodies shrouded in dark atmosphere.

picks.title: Lovestories
picks.highlight: 神秘新人的浪漫EP,轻盈电子与温柔人声,像深夜电台里偶然遇见的好歌。
picks.highlightEn: A promising newcomer's romantic EP — airy electronics and soft vocals, like a late-night radio discovery.
picks.summary: 艺人ENKAY的浪漫主题EP,风格轻盈,以电子与流行人声为主,属新晋音乐人的尝试之作。
picks.summaryEn: ENKAY's romance-themed EP is light and airy, pairing gentle electronics with soft pop vocals — a promising debut voice.

picks.title: The Power Station
picks.highlight: 80年代超级组合唯一专辑重现,放克吉他与人声的化学反应,一次就难忘。
picks.highlightEn: The 80s supergroup's lone album returns — funky guitars and powerhouse vocals in one unforgettable blast.
picks.summary: 1985年超级组合The Power Station同名专辑再版,放克摇滚与华丽流行结合,制作精良。
picks.summaryEn: Reissue of the 1985 supergroup's only album: funky rock riffing meets glossy pop polish and giant vocals.

picks.title: Big Cock
picks.highlight: 英国心理摇滚怪咖的疯狂之作,狂野洛卡比里节奏,一场不正经的复古派对。
picks.highlightEn: British psychobilly eccentrics at their wildest — frantic rockabilly rhythms and gleefully bad taste.
picks.summary: 英国心理摇滚乐队King Kurt作品,融合洛卡比里与朋克,风格戏谑狂野、复古味浓。
picks.summaryEn: King Kurt mash rockabilly and punk into rowdy, tongue-in-cheek party music with a heavy retro streak.

picks.title: Von Abseits
picks.highlight: 德国地下嘻哈老将新专辑,冷峻叙事与实验节拍,德语说唱的另一种可能。
picks.highlightEn: Veteran German underground rap — cold-eyed storytelling over experimental beats, another side of Deutschrap.
picks.summary: 德国嘻哈组合Doppelkopf新专辑,德语说唱搭配实验性节拍,叙事冷峻,地下气质明显。
picks.summaryEn: Doppelkopf's new album pairs German rap with experimental beats and icy narratives — underground to the core.
